derivation: Crucibles are built in the world (iron) or upgraded in place; the Enderite crucible and barrel (age-of-game tier 5, rows moved from SimpleBuilding with split stage 5) are the only ones a wandering trader may carry; the copper and Enderite buckets (rows moved from SimpleBuilding with split stage 5b) keep their prices, filled buckets are never traded.

excluded.simplecrucibles:crucible_blank: Exists only half-built in the world; no item.
excluded.simplecrucibles:soul_lava_bucket: Soul lava is a world-generation rarity (0.5 % springs, 10 % fortress wells); no trade.
excluded.simplecrucibles:enderite_soul_lava_bucke: Filled only by scooping soul lava; no trade.
excluded.simplecrucibles:copper_water_bucket: Filled bucket; buy the empty one.
excluded.simplecrucibles:copper_lava_bucket: Filled bucket; buy the empty one.
excluded.simplecrucibles:enderite_water_bucket: Filled bucket; buy the empty one.
excluded.simplecrucibles:enderite_lava_bucket: Filled bucket; buy the empty one.
excluded.simplecrucibles:enderite_water_bucket_fu: Filled bucket (two buckets); buy the empty one.
excluded.simplecrucibles:enderite_lava_bucket_ful: Filled bucket (two buckets); buy the empty one.
excluded.simplecrucibles:enderite_soul_lava_bucke: Filled only by scooping soul lava twice; no trade.
excluded.simplecrucibles:enderite_milk_bucket: Filled bucket (milked); buy the empty one.
